user_direction: Do not dismiss results that improve expected returns and lower max DD just because they do not meet the max DD threshold
supersedes: Earlier rules making 8% baseline / 10% combined DD mandatory promotion cutoffs
target_interpretation: Preferences and comparison annotations, not rejection gates
target_profile_rule: Choose the highest combined-stress return within 8%/10%, with baseline return as tie-breaker; disclose activity separately. The separate frequency profile already represents the activity floor. Clarified before the calibrated 65% replay completed.
retention: Retain all completed trials and the full return/drawdown/frequency frontier. Explicitly retain higher-return/lower-drawdown candidates above the preferred targets.
finalist_profiles: Strongest paired return/drawdown improvement over the last audited incumbent, with trade-count differences disclosed
Strongest frequency-preserving candidate with drawdown no worse than the incumbent
Best candidate within the preferred drawdown targets if distinct from the preceding profiles
unchanged_requirements: No invalid execution or liquidation exceptions; full standard audits for delivered configurations; no June-July optimisation; changed-management comparisons remain provisional until their value-target mismatch is addressed
